props.name: children
props.comment:
The inputs to edit with; their values become the patch for every row. Flat
sources only: applying with a dirty nested source (`address.city`,
`tags[1]`) notifies an error and calls nothing.

props.name: onSuccess
props.comment: Runs after a successful update with the sent fields and the updated ids.

props.name: side
props.comment: Edge the sheet slides in from. Default `"right"`.
